description: Authorizes an autonomous agent's payment to a vendor after validating the vendor is on the agent's allowlist, the payment stays within the agent's credential limit, and the agent has not exceeded its payment velocity limit.

unboundSignalReasons.vendorAllowed: Result of checking the vendor against the agent's issued credential scope; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.withinCredentialLimit: Result of comparing the payment amount against the agent's issued credential limit; computed independently of the Intent.
unboundSignalReasons.withinVelocityLimit: Result of an independent check against the agent's recent payment activity; not expressible via the Intent's target/parameters.

outcome.reason: Agent payment authorized. Vendor allowlist, credential limit, and velocity requirements were satisfied.
Agent payment rejected because the vendor is not on the agent's authorized vendor list.
Agent payment rejected because the payment amount exceeds the agent's credential limit.
Agent payment rejected because the agent exceeded its allowed payment velocity.
Agent payment rejected because the payment amount must be greater than zero.
Agent payment rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
